value: At the Frozen Throne, the living confront the Lich King at the crown of his fortress. Tirion Fordring breaks free and brings Ashbringer against Frostmourne, shattering the cursed blade; the assault ends in Arthas's defeat. Shadowmourne is present because its bearer has reached the final challenge, but it is not the sole cause of victory. In the aftermath, a sealed chest is found beside the fallen king.
editorNote: Research status: the cited quest/item mirrors support this original paraphrase, but original Wrath client/build capture and human lore review remain required. Do not infer a canonical player, exact cross-story date, exact return-NPC placement, or later Arthas outcome.
